div.span: discovery-handler pulls agent records and signals from each source (Bedrock Agents, AgentCore, and external platforms like Microsoft / Okta / MuleSoft) - on demand via /discovery/sync and every 6h via EventBridge - and upserts normalized records into DynamoDB. It never sits in an agent request path.
